after_snippet:
import numpy as np

# In 2.0.0+, out-of-range Python integers raise OverflowError
try:
    result = np.where(True, 300, 0, dtype=np.uint8)
    # Should raise OverflowError, so reaching here means test fails
    raise AssertionError("Expected OverflowError")
except OverflowError:
    pass  # Expected behavior
before_snippet:
import numpy as np

# In 1.26.4, large Python integers were silently truncated
result = np.where(True, 300, 0, dtype=np.uint8)
assert result == 44  # 300 & 0xFF = 44
title: numpy.where no longer truncates Python integers to output dtype
